title: 第5章 双倍收获太爽了第6章 扶摇怎么开始脑补了
slug: 我的徒弟们都太逆天了
lines: 数个时辰后。
姬扶摇缓缓睁开双眸，星眸闪烁。
她的道基已经完全修复，散发出无比璀璨的光芒，熠熠夺目，如同一轮明月映照她的体内世界。
姬扶摇有些激动。
现在她的资质，比起上一世强大了不知道多少！
她的心中再次燃起了希望。
重新崛起！
这一世，她将变得更强！
姬扶摇喃喃说道。
“现在只是吞下了道基丹，就已经如同恐怖了，等到我开始修炼《大道经》，到时候就可以打造完美道基！”
“完美道基啊！若是成功打造完美道基，这一世我将登上修炼绝巅！”
她充满了自信。
而且，她的扶摇皇朝，也将重新崛起！
上一次皇朝遭受血洗，她的三大部下皆是逃出了一些精锐，如今隐匿在南荒之中，等待她的召唤！
姬扶摇心潮涌动，咬着唇瓣说道。
“等我踏入玄宗境之后，就可以去联系旧部了！”
片刻后。
姬扶摇运转灵诀，想看看修炼速度。
她的功法是一星帝阶，《玄火经》！
瞬间，无比磅礴的灵能涌入她的丹田之中。
姬扶摇有些震惊。
道基补全之后，修炼速度提升了十倍！
这一次，拜师陆玄竟然误打误撞，让她得到了这么大的好处！
如此机缘，堪称逆天！
她突然想道。
陆玄让她做饭，恐怕是找一个理由送她拜师礼！
师父有心了啊。
姬扶摇的心中涌起一道暖流。
一时间，她对陆玄产生了很大的好奇。
姬扶摇唇瓣微启，美眸流转，“陆玄，你到底有什么秘密？”
“不过，道基丹也有可能是前代峰主留下的。”
“再观察几日。”
说着，她取出在大道殿领取的身份令牌。
她的神识探入，一道恢弘霸道的声音充斥在她识海之中，玄妙晦涩的力量涌动，仿若穿越时空，轰然开口。
“拜入大道宗者，立天道誓言，永不得背叛大道宗！”
姬扶摇知道，这是大道宗的一种大手笔，利用上古秘法让弟子立天誓！
这是上古秘法，极其难以破解！
一旦立下誓言，她这一世就是大道宗弟子了！
即使她重铸扶摇皇朝的荣耀，成为扶摇女帝，依旧是大道宗弟子。
content_en:
A few hours later.
Ji Fuyao slowly opened her eyes, her starry eyes twinkling.
Her Daoji has been completely repaired, emitting an extremely bright light, dazzling like a bright moon reflecting the world inside her body.
Ji Fuyao was a little excited.
Her qualifications now are much stronger than those in her previous life!
Hope reignited in her heart.
Rise again!
In this life, she will become stronger!
Ji Fuyao murmured.
"Now, just swallowing the Daoji Pill is already terrifying. When I start practicing the "Dao Jing", I will be able to create a perfect Daoji!"
"Perfect Dao Foundation! If I successfully create the perfect Dao Foundation, I will reach the pinnacle of cultivation in this life!"
She is full of confidence.
Moreover, her Fuyao Dynasty will also rise again!
The last time the dynasty suffered a bloodbath, some of her three major subordinates escaped and are now hiding in the southern wasteland, waiting for her call!
Ji Fuyao's heart surged and she bit her lip and said.
"After I step into the Xuanzong realm, I can contact the old department!"
After a while.
Ji Fuyao was running the spirit formula to see how fast he was practicing.
Her technique is a one-star emperor level, "Xuanhuo Jing"!
"Boom!"
In an instant, extremely majestic spiritual energy poured into her Dantian.
Ji Fuyao was a little shocked.
After completing the Dao Foundation, the cultivation speed increased ten times!
This time, her apprenticeship with Lu Xuan was unexpected and she got such great benefits!
Such an opportunity is incredible!
she suddenly thought.
Lu Xuan asked her to cook, probably because he was looking for a reason to give her a apprenticeship ceremony!
Master is interested.
A warm current surged in Ji Fuyao's heart.
For a moment, she became very curious about Lu Xuan.
Ji Fuyao's lips parted slightly, her beautiful eyes moved, "Lu Xuan, what secret do you have?"
"However, it is possible that the Daoji Pill was left behind by the previous peak master."
"Observe for a few more days."
With that said, she took out the identity token she received at the Avenue Hall.
Her consciousness penetrated, and a majestic and domineering voice filled her sea of ​​consciousness. Mysterious and obscure power surged, as if she had traveled through time and space, and spoke loudly.
"Those who join the Dao Dao Sect take an oath to heaven and never betray the Dao Dao Sect!"
Ji Fuyao knew that this was a grand gesture of the Dao Dao Sect, using ancient secret techniques to make disciples make an oath to heaven!
This is an ancient secret method that is extremely difficult to crack!
Once she makes the oath, she will be a disciple of the Dao Sect in this life!
Even if she recasts the glory of the Fuyao Dynasty and becomes the Empress of Fuyao, she is still a disciple of the Dao Dao Sect.
